breakdown.note: tests/lint scored from author evidence plus diff review; evaluator did not run make (clone busy). Confirm make test green before merge.

findings.issue: Weakened Sun check (R>=190, R>=G>=B, R-B<=40) passes pure white, grey, or an un-lifted tint, and a broken saturation (star_saturation stuck at 1) would still pass. It no longer asserts the lift. No GPU check on Aldebaran or TRAPPIST-1 colour (C4 is eyeballed only). 'brightest' is still computed but unused in ok.

Lift t=max(0,1+(tint-1)*2.2) clamps below at 0 but not above, and tint is unit-luminance so channels >1 are amplified (red on cool stars about 2.7), so luminance rises above the 1.2 fader target. Blue goes to 0 (fully saturated). Behaviour is plausible but untested; no unit check for tints with channels >1 or <0.

Mid and late approach discs are white with a yellow halo, not golden; only the arrived frame is golden orange. Colour jump across approach is inconsistent with the stated goal and unexplained. approach_start shows no disc at all (starbow), which fits the design.
The clip_max trailing comment ('the Sun's disc is clipped here...') now sits on the star_saturation line; misleading.

Test name claims main-sequence stars and planets keep 25 s but only index 9 is asserted; entry gamma (about 12) and the 25 deg start are not pinned. A giantTiming applied to every leg would pass. Only Aldebaran is switched in legs() (verified), and the GD test pins 1800 vs 500 ticks per leg, which does cover the others.
Hardcoded 1800/500 ticks and id=='aldebaran'; duplicates sim timing. Fractions 1/2 and 17/20 are correct for the stated design.

Realistic is untouched: star_saturation is set to 1.0 unless body_fader, FADER_STAR_TARGET only used by the fader; HUD label added only on the Auto line. Honest labelling is present but terse ('star colours enhanced', not stating that it is a chroma lift of 2.2x).
